project.title: The Pali Residence
project.intro: A 3,200 sq ft family residence in the heart of Pali Hill, reimagined as a calm, layered interior that balances warmth with restraint. Every material was chosen for its tactile quality and its ability to age gracefully.
project.challenge: The existing layout fragmented the social spaces into disconnected rooms, and the large windows — while flooding the apartment with light — had no cohesive response in the material palette.
project.response: We opened the living, dining, and kitchen into a single continuous plane, anchored by a long limestone island and a full-height bookwall. The window frames were treated as architectural moments, each with a deep sill and woven roman blind.

nextProject.title: Altitude Penthouse
nextProject.intro: A sky-level penthouse with panoramic sea views required a design language that would not compete with the horizon. We chose restraint — deep tones, natural stone, and a palette that recedes to let the city speak.
nextProject.challenge: With floor-to-ceiling glass on three sides, the interior risked feeling like a showroom. The challenge was grounding the space without closing it in.
nextProject.response: Dark walnut joinery and smoked oak floors created depth and weight. The furniture plan was kept deliberately sparse — anchoring without crowding. A custom steel-and-glass staircase connects the two levels with sculptural precision.
